# Gimel Mobile

> Docs for building the Gimel Android app (Google Pixel 8, native APK with ARCore) against the
> Gimel REST API. Docs only so far; no app code exists. LAN-only product, German UI.

Read in this order:

- [README](README.md): index, trust level of each file, rules
- [Plan](PLAN.md): steps 0 and A–G, decisions, risks
- [Android APK spec](ANDROID-APK.md): architecture, trust, session, AR, positioning, privacy
- [Copilot / Agent API](AGENT-API.md): chats, SSE events, context, UI actions, voice, gaps
- [All current routes](API-CURRENT.md): 357 operations, new ones marked
- [OpenAPI](openapi.json): exact schemas (375 KB)

## Legacy

- [GIMEL.md](GIMEL.md): product, auth §5, domain model. Built from old code; no agent routes, old 3D. Newer files win.
